Plot a Funnel Chart following WJP style guidelines

Source: R/funnelChart.R
wjp_funnel.Rd

wjp_funnel() draws the stages of a pathway (e.g., the justice journey) as centered horizontal bars whose width is proportional to their value, joined by light connectors, with the value printed inside each bar and the stage labels in a column at the left.

Usage

wjp_funnel(
  data,
  target,
  grouping,
  labels = NULL,
  order = NULL,
  bar_height = 40,
  gap = 18,
  connectors = TRUE,
  connector_color = "#A8A8C8",
  connector_alpha = 0.45,
  color = "#575796",
  value_face = "bold",
  value_size = 11,
  value_color = "#FFFFFF",
  label_size = 10,
  label_colour = "#524F4C",
  label_width = NULL,
  label_gap = 16,
  label_lineheight = 1.22,
  panel_width = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  margins = c(4, 4, 4, 2),
  ptheme = WJP_theme()
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing the data to plot.

target

String. Column name of the variable with the value of each stage (it sets the width of the bars).

grouping

String. Column name of the variable with the stage labels.

labels

String. Column name of the variable with the printed values. Default is NULL (rounded percentages of target).

order

String. Column name of the variable with the display order of the stages (top to bottom). Default is NULL (data order).

bar_height

Numeric. Height of each bar, in points. Default is 40.

gap

Numeric. Vertical gap between bars, in points. Default is 18.

connectors

Logical. Draw connectors between consecutive bars. Default is TRUE.

connector_color

String. Color of the connectors. Default is "#A8A8C8".

connector_alpha

Numeric. Opacity of the connectors. Default is 0.45.

color

String. Color of the bars. Default is "#575796".

value_face

String. Font face of the values: "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic", or a weight face such as "semibold.italic" (see wjp_fonts()). Default is "bold".

value_size

Numeric. Size of the values, in points. Default is 11.

value_color

String. Color of the values. Default is "#FFFFFF".

label_size

Numeric. Size of the stage labels, in points. Default is 10.

label_colour

String. Color of the stage labels. Default is "#524F4C".

label_width

Numeric. Maximum width of a label line, in points, used to wrap labels without line breaks. Default is NULL (no wrapping).

label_gap

Numeric. Gap between the label column and the bar area, in points. Default is 16.

label_lineheight

Numeric. Distance between the baselines of label lines, in multiples of the label size. Default is 1.22.

panel_width

Numeric. Width of the bar area, in points. Default is NULL (see width).

width

Numeric. Total width of the figure, in points; the bar area takes the space left by the label column and the margins. Default is NULL (the bar area fills the device when panel_width is also NULL).

margins

Numeric vector of four margins (top, right, bottom, left), in points. Default is c(4, 4, 4, 2).

ptheme

ggplot theme to apply. Default is WJP_theme().

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

The function expects one row per stage: the stage label in grouping and its value in target. The widest bar (the largest value) spans the whole bar area; the others are scaled relative to it and centered. Stages are drawn from top to bottom in data order, or in the order given by the order column. The printed values come from the labels column as given; without it, values are printed as rounded percentages.

Stage labels keep their line breaks (newline characters); labels without them are wrapped to label_width points when it is supplied. They are right-aligned label_gap points before the bar area, and centered on their bar.

Geometry is set in points: each bar is bar_height points high, bars are gap points apart, and margins surround the chart. The bar area is panel_width points wide, or fills a figure of width points (the label column is measured with the active font family). With either of them, the chart has a definite size and wjp_save() needs no width or height. The label column is measured with systemfonts when it knows the font family (see wjp_fonts()), and estimated otherwise.

Examples

# Always load the WJP fonts
wjp_fonts()

# Stages of the justice journey (fictional data)
journey <- data.frame(
  stage = c("Had access to information and advice",
            "Obtained appropriate assistance\nwhen they needed it",
            "Turned to a dispute resolution\nmechanism when they needed it"),
  value = c(61, 32, 28)
)
journey$text <- paste0(journey$value, "%")

wjp_funnel(
  journey,
  target   = "value",
  grouping = "stage",
  labels   = "text",
  width    = 468
)
